title: Payment Arrangements Policy — Booking the Plan Total, Completion and Release of the Remainder
content:
The arrangement balance of a plan under Payment Arrangements is the amount still scheduled to be paid under it: the plan total less installments paid, plus installments returned, less any remainder released when the plan ends unfinished.

## Clauses

1. The plan total is booked to the arrangement once, on the creation date, for exactly the plan total.
2. A plan is completed on the day its arrangement balance reaches zero through installment payments, and the account then closes as paid in full unless a supplemental balance added after creation is still owed, in which case the account returns to active with that amount due.
3. A remainder is released only for a plan whose status is cancelled, once, on the cancellation date, for the whole arrangement balance remaining; the released amount stays owed on the account and is never forgiven by the release.
4. A plan is never completed by a settlement waiver, a client credit or a direct payment; those reduce the account balance and the plan is cancelled with the close reason "account resolved otherwise" when the account is closed by them.

The plan's status, read from its record, decides whether a release may be booked; the amount released equals the arrangement balance remaining on the cancellation date.

## Outcomes

| What brings the arrangement balance or the account to an end | Plan outcome | Account outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Installment payments bring the arrangement balance to zero, no supplemental balance owed | Completed | Closes as paid in full |
| Installment payments bring the arrangement balance to zero, a supplemental balance added after creation still owed | Completed | Returns to active with that amount due |
| A settlement waiver, client credit or direct payment closes the account | Cancelled — "account resolved otherwise" | Closed by those movements |
| The plan is cancelled for any reason | A one-time release of the whole remaining arrangement balance on the cancellation date | The released amount stays owed |

## Hypothetical figures

A plan total of 1500.00 is booked on the creation date. Installments of 500.00 and 500.00 are paid, and one of 500.00 is returned and booked back: the arrangement balance stands at 1000.00. If the plan is then cancelled, 1000.00 is released on the cancellation date and the account still owes it.
